note: No university id is registered yet for Al-Azhar University Damietta -- 'azd' is this lane's working prefix, pending the chief of staff registering it. The corpus's official Year 1/Year 2/Year 3 tree (documented in README - Library Guide.md) is almost entirely empty folder scaffolding: only schedules, a student guide, and two university-wide admin PDFs sit inside it. The only real academic content in the whole 112-file tree is 12 Telegram-sourced PDFs sitting OUTSIDE that documented tree, under a separate 'Faculty of Medicine/Year 1/<informal module name>/_Telegram Year 1 Archive/' path that the README does not mention at all. Telegram fetching is retired; these 12 files were already resident on Desktop (dated 2026-08-31, per Faculty of Medicine/Year 1/_Catalog/Year 1 Priority 4.md) before this lane started -- no new fetch was performed. 46 .DS_Store files were excluded from this manifest as OS metadata, not source content.
scopeNote: This manifest covers Year 1 + the two university-wide shared admin files + the corpus's top-level catalog notes (38 files) -- the scope this lane authors from. Year 2 (14 files) and Year 3 (14 files) exist in the same corpus under the same empty-scaffold-plus-schedules pattern, with no Telegram-archive content found for either; their files are not itemised here (out of scope for a Y1 lane) but are accounted for in manifest/y1-sources.md's counts and this lane's report. Total non-.DS_Store files across the whole corpus: 66.
